rules.title: SerializeField over public
rules.text: Use [SerializeField] private fields instead of public fields for inspector values.

rules.title: Cache references
rules.text: Cache component references in Awake and avoid GetComponent and Find in Update.

rules.title: Object pooling
rules.text: Pool frequently spawned objects instead of instantiating and destroying them.

rules.title: ScriptableObjects for data
rules.text: Keep configuration and shared data in ScriptableObjects.

rules.title: Avoid per-frame allocations
rules.text: Avoid allocations in Update such as LINQ, string concatenation and new collections.

rules.title: Commit .meta files
rules.text: Commit .meta files and never edit scene or prefab YAML by hand without need.
